# impluvium

Unofficial, personal fork of [Drop](https://github.com/Drop-OSS/drop), provided **as-is, without support**.

It is maintained for one personal setup (a Linux desktop that uses Steam as its launcher) and is not a successor to
Drop. For anything about Drop itself, please use the upstream project.

Changes in this fork are developed with AI assistance (Claude Code). In line with Drop's
[no-AI contributions policy](https://developer.droposs.org/contributing), they are not submitted upstream.

- Upstream README: [README.md](../README.md)
- Licence: AGPL-3.0, as upstream (see `server/LICENSE`, `desktop/LICENSE`). Code under `engine/` (once added) is 0BSD.
- Contributions: see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
